jobs.title: Associate Process Engineer, Student
jobs.description_md:
Student - Optimization Engineer for Operations Research

**Your impact begins here**

As Optimization Engineer Student you will apply what you learn at university to real decisions in Novo's pharmaceutical production. You will build and use mathematical models that support capacity planning, production planning and scheduling across the manufacturing landscape. Working in a specialised optimisation team in Kalundborg, you will see how data, modelling and optimisation lead to better decisions in manufacturing, and how those decisions help treatments reach people living with serious chronic diseases.

**What you’ll bring**

We are looking for a student with a strong analytical mindset and a genuine interest in optimisation, modelling and supply chain analysis. You enjoy solving complex problems with a systems approach, and you want to see your solutions work in an industrial manufacturing supply chain.

**Essential:**

•      You are enrolled in an MSc programme at a Danish university within Industrial Engineering and Management, Business Analytics, Mathematical Modelling, Chemical Engineering or a related discipline.

•      You have at least three semesters remaining in your studies.

•      Your studies focus on supply chain, operations research and/or operations management, mathematical modelling or optimisation.

**Useful, but not essential:**

•      A solid understanding of mathematical programming, for example from tools or languages such as Pyomo, Gurobi, Python or similar.

**What you’ll do**

You will be part of the work that turns mathematical models into practical support for manufacturing decisions. Your tasks will vary, and will focus on mathematical programming for supply chain analysis, capacity planning, and production planning and scheduling.

•      Develop and apply mathematical models, including mixed-integer linear programming (MILP) and related optimisation methods.

•      Support and drive optimisation projects focused on data analysis, capacity planning, production planning and scheduling.

•      Contribute to digital development and other advanced modelling initiatives within manufacturing operations.

•      Bring theoretical concepts and analytical methods from your studies into real industrial challenges.

•      Use data, modelling and optimisation to help colleagues make better decisions.

**Who you’ll work with**

You will be part of Global Manufacturing & Supply, where colleagues work across the value chain to scale processes and products for the people who need them. Within it, Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients is responsible for manufacturing all active pharmaceutical ingredients (API) for Novo’s products.

You will be assigned to Manufacturing 2 (M2), the original production area in Kalundborg, and employed in M2 Bioprocess Improvement-Optimization (M2 BIO). The group has 7 highly skilled colleagues, alongside a number of students and interns. Together you work with advanced process modelling, simulation, analysis, control and optimisation, representing (bio-)chemical digital twins and the pharmaceutical supply chain.

The team has a trusting, inclusive and enthusiastic work environment. Colleagues support each other, and they look forward to making you feel welcome.

**What you can expect here**

As a student, you will have the opportunity to grow by applying your academic knowledge to real-world industrial challenges. You will gain experience of working in a global company and a manufacturing environment, and learn how data, modelling and optimisation support better decision-making. You will be supported to perform at your best, trusted to take ownership and encouraged to make your voice heard.

This position is hourly paid. For this position, the hourly base rate is **241,34 DKK**, based on an assessment of relevant factors such as experience, educational background, demonstrated competencies, and the specific skills required for the position.

In addition to the hourly base rate, Student Assistants are entitled to a pension scheme (currently 10% employer contribution and 5% employee contribution).

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

**Start now**

Your impact begins today. If you are ready to turn your studies into practical optimisation work in pharmaceutical manufacturing, apply for the Optimization Engineer Student role by **27 November 2026**. Interviews will take place on **5 and 6 January 2027**.

For further information, please contact **Astrid Rosendal Madsen** at **ARQD@novonordisk.com**.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

jobs.title: P&O Student Assistant
jobs.location: Ørestad, Capital Region of Denmark, DK
jobs.description_md:
**Your impact begins here**

As our P&O Student Assistant, you will help keep People & Organisation (P&O) running smoothly. You will support a variety of activities across administration, communication and events, from welcoming new colleagues to keeping information accurate and easy to access. Along the way, we encourage you to bring your ideas and help us find smarter and simpler ways of working.

**What you’ll bring**

You are studying, curious and organised, and you like making things work for other people.

* Currently enrolled in a university or business school programme, preferably in your 2nd or 3rd year within human resources or a similar field.
* Fluency in Danish and English, written and spoken.
* The ability to prioritise your studies alongside part-time work and meet deadlines without compromising quality.
* Attention to detail and accuracy when handling administrative information and following established guidelines.
* A proactive, can-do attitude, with the adaptability and learning agility to pick up new tasks, processes and digital tools quickly.
* Clear written and verbal communication, and a collaborative approach to working with colleagues.

**Useful, but not essential:**

Familiarity with HR activities or related tasks. Prior experience is preferred but not required.

**What you’ll do**

You will be the extra pair of hands and fresh pair of eyes that keeps P&O operations accurate, organised and moving.

* Keep P&O information accurate and accessible by updating SharePoint sites, managing content and permissions, and maintaining distribution lists and hierarchy overviews across affiliates.
* Create posts on Viva Engage and contribute to internal P&O communication, building a strong understanding of the organisational structure as you go.
* Support HR administration, including the archive, organisational organograms, and updates to employee information and organisational changes.
* Support onboarding and exit processes together with the P&O Partnering Professional, including IT system access, training schedules and orientation materials, as well as planning, coordination and booking for exits.
* Handle practical office and fleet administration for the Danish affiliate, including BroBizz, parking and parking permits, and support compliant and efficient purchasing.
* Support the PA and Internal Communication Professional with company days, events, seminars, meetings and catering, and contribute ideas to process optimisation and digital tools that reduce complexity.
* Handle procurement and purchasing activities, including purchase orders, invoice follow-up and related administration.
* Support with general ad hoc tasks and activities across P&O.

**Who you’ll work with**

You will join People & Organisation within International Operations, where colleagues work across markets to serve people around the world and help improve health at scale. You will report to the People and Organisation Director. As part of a team of five, you will work closely with the P&O Partnering Professional and the PA & Internal Communication Professional in your day-to-day role.

You will also collaborate with colleagues and stakeholders from different functions and affiliates, and take part in cross-functional discussions where we encourage you to bring your own ideas and perspectives. By staying organised, proactive and focused on priorities, you will help keep things moving and make a valuable contribution to the team.

**What you can expect here**

You will learn from experienced professionals and get a close view of how P&O supports a global organisation. You will build practical skills in HR administration, process improvement and internal communication, and be trusted to take ownership of your tasks and make your voice heard.

This is a one-year contract with the possibility of extension. The role is approximately 15–20 hours per week, with flexibility to increase or reduce your hours depending on your studies.

**Salary and Benefits**

This position is hourly paid, and the hourly base rate is DKK 209,27. In addition to the hourly base rate, Student Assistants are entitled to a pension scheme (currently 10% employer contribution and 5% employee contribution).

**Start now**

Your impact begins today. If you are ready to bring structure, curiosity and a can-do attitude to P&O, apply for the P&O Student Intern role by 30 November 2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

Nykredit bruger egne cookies samt cookies fra tredjeparter til at indsamle og behandle oplysninger om din adfærd på hjemmesiden til funktionelle, statistiske og markedsføringsmæssige formål.

Hvis du giver samtykke til brug af markedsføringscookies, så videregiver vi oplysninger om din adfærd på hjemmesiden til vores koncernforbundne selskaber og tredjeparter, som vi samarbejder med. Det gør vi med henblik på, at disse parter må behandle oplysningerne for at vise dig markedsføring på denne og andre hjemmesider samt sociale medier.​

Ved at klikke på ”Accepter alle” giver du samtykke til, at vi indsamler og behandler oplysninger fra cookies og videregiver disse oplysninger til alle de beskrevne formål og modtagere. Du kan også vælge, hvilke formål du vil give samtykke til, ved at benytte knapperne ud for formålet, og derefter klikke på ”Accepter valgte”. Under "Om cookies” kan du se hvilke koncernforbundne selskaber vi samarbejder med, og under "Vis detaljer”, kan du se en beskrivelse af de forskellige formål og cookies.​ Du kan til enhver tid ændre eller trække dit samtykke tilbage via det lille cookieikon i venstre hjørne af hjemmesiden. Du kan læse mere om vores brug af cookies og modtagerne af oplysningerne her, ligesom du kan læse mere om vores behandling af personoplysninger her.

Bliv studentermedhjælper i Capital and Liquidity

Har du interesse for at skabe robuste dataløsninger i en stor finansiel virksomhed? Og vil du kombinere teoretisk viden med praktisk erfaring inden for finansielle data, kodning og rapportering? Så er du måske vores nye studentermedhjælper.

Som studentermedhjælper i Capital and Liquidity spiller du en vigtig rolle i kapitalteamet, der har ansvaret for drift af koncernens kapitalkravsberegning samt beregning og rapportering af kapitalnøgletal og risikoeksponeringer til myndighederne. Beregningerne er baseret på omfattende kode og store mængder data.

I samarbejde med kapitalteamet skal du udvikle og vedligeholde dataløsninger til beregning af kapitalkrav for hele Nykredit-koncernen. Du får særligt fokus på at forbedre og automatisere eksisterende løsninger og afprøve nye tilgange til arbejdet med data.

Du bliver også en del af Nykredit-koncernen, hvor vi bl.a. lover muligheder og udvikling til dig, der vil og kan. Det vil du også opleve gennem vores studenternetværk, Nykredit Youth. Her bliver du løbende inviteret til faglige oplæg og arrangementer, hvor du får mulighed for at netværke med andre studentermedhjælpere fra hele koncernen.

Motiveres du af kodning og arbejdet med data?
Så er du landet rigtigt. Som studentermedhjælper hos os kan du se frem til at:

Udvikle og vedligeholde kode til databehandling og kapitalkravsberegning.
Afprøve nye tilgange til konkrete dataopgaver og teste, om løsningerne virker efter hensigten.
Analysere store datamængder og undersøge afvigelser i data og beregningsresultater
Forbedre og automatisere eksisterende dataprocesser og beregningsopsætninger
Bidrage til beregning og rapportering af kapitalnøgletal.

Arbejdstiden er gennemsnitligt ca. 15 timer om ugen fordelt over to-tre arbejdsdage, og vi tager naturligvis hensyn til dine eksamensperioder. Ud over opgaverne relateret til afdelingen vil du indgå i en gruppe af studentermedhjælpere, der sammen dækker en række mindre administrative opgaver for hele området.

Er det dig, vi leder efter?
Vi forestiller os, at du er i gang med en relevant matematisk, økonomisk, datalogisk eller anden teknisk uddannelse og har interesse for kodning og arbejdet med større datamængder.

Vi lægger især vægt på, at du:

har erfaring med kodning, fx fra dit studie, arbejde eller egne projekter,
har lyst til at bruge og videreudvikle dine færdigheder inden for store datamængder og finansielle problemstillinger,
er nysgerrig på forskellige løsningsmuligheder og har lyst til at afprøve idéer, undersøge fejl og justere dine løsninger undervejs,
er omhyggelig med at teste og forstå dine resultater og søger sparring, når du har brug for det,
har flair for tal og kan formidle dine resultater klart både skriftligt og mundtligt, og har blik for den forretningsmæssige sammenhæng, tallene indgår i.

Det er en fordel, hvis du har erfaring med SAS, SQL, R eller Python, samt Excel.

Som studentermedhjælper i Funding & Kapital får du mulighed for at udvikle dine faglige og personlige kompetencer gennem konkrete opgaver og samarbejde med erfarne kolleger.

Dit nye team
Du bliver en del af Capital and Liquidity, som består af 15 specialister med gode muligheder for faglig sparring. Capital and Liquidity ligger i Funding & Kapital, der er en del af Treasury & Kredit-området i Nykredit-koncernen. I teamet har vi en uformel omgangstone med plads til godt humør, og vi samarbejder bredt på tværs af koncernen, blandt andet med Kredit, IT og de forretningsvendte enheder.

Vi glæder os til at tage godt imod dig som vores nye kollega.

Vil du vide mere?
Du er velkommen til at kontakte analytiker Julie Bennetzen på 26 34 29 01 eller chefanalytiker Jannick Klinge på 50 78 06 10, hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen.

Har du spørgsmål til rekrutteringsprocessen, kan du kontakte rekrutteringsteamet på nytjob@nykredit.dk.

Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning, dit CV og karakterbevis. Fortæl gerne kort i din ansøgning om en opgave eller et projekt, hvor du har brugt kode: Hvad ville du løse, hvad prøvede du, og hvad lærte du undervejs?

Vi inviterer løbende til samtaler og opfordrer dig derfor til at sende din ansøgning hurtigst muligt.

Nykredit-koncernen er nemlig ejet af en forening af vores kunder, Forenet Kredit. Det giver os bl.a. nogle særlige muligheder for at dele vores fremgang med vores kunder, fx gennem konkrete fordele, der gør det billigere at være kunde hos os. Det mærker man også i de lokalområder, vi er til stede i – fx når alle vores rådgivere i Nykredit og Spar Nord hvert år får et beløb til rådighed til at gøre en forskel for en lokal forening eller klub. Det kalder vi Det lokale løfte.  

Som kollega mærker du også vores foreningsejerskab. Vi giver fx et medarbejderløfte, hvor vi lover udvikling og muligheder til dig, der vil og kan. Du vil derfor opleve, at din leder er ambitiøs – ikke mindst på dine vegne – og er trænet i at støtte din udvikling og guide dig videre, når du er klar til næste skridt i din karriere. Selvfølgelig i Nykredit-koncernen. 

På tværs af Nykredit og Spar Nord får du cirka 5.500 nye kolleger, der sammen skaber vores foreningsejede arbejdsplads. Det gør vi med en kultur, der er præget af holdånd, ligeværd og handlekraft. Og med målet om at give vores kunder markedets bedste oplevelser.  

Dét er bare nogle af fordelene ved at være en del af vores foreningsejede arbejdsplads.  

Nykredit-koncernen omfatter bl.a. følgende brands Nykredit, Spar Nord, Totalkredit, Nybolig og Sparinvest. 

Læs mere om ansættelsesprocessen samt vores behandling af personoplysninger.

jobs.title: Student Assistant - Project Management Office and Administration
jobs.description_md:
**Student Assistant - Project Management Office and Administration**
Aarhus, Denmark

Are you interested in gaining project management and administrative experience within a specialised and technical team? Do you want to support project management work that connects clients, suppliers, and senior experts? Are you a proactive student who values accuracy, clear communication, and on-the-job learning?

If this sounds like you, or you’re curious to learn more, then this role could be the perfect opportunity. Join our Power Systems Global Competence Centre as our new student assistant and work with us to close the gap to a sustainable future.

**Your new role**
As our new Student Assistant, you will provide commercial and administrative support to the Power Systems Global Competence Centre. You will be part of our Power Systems department, a globally connected unit of approximately 30 specialists working closely with clients and suppliers on large utility-scale electrical power projects, forming the backbone of tomorrows energy system.

In this role you’ll join a dynamic, globally connected team delivering a broad portfolio of international projects. You will engage regularly with clients and suppliers across sectors and regions, supporting project management activities from initial enquiries through delivery and helping to strengthen long-term partnerships. The position is ideal for a student looking for practical project management experience alongside their studies.

Your key responsibilities will be:

* Provide general administrative support to the team
* Assist with the design, preparation and formatting of documents and presentations for internal and external use.
* Maintain and update records, contact lists and basic CRM entries.
* Support meeting logistics: scheduling, preparing agendas, taking minutes and following up on action items.
* Carry out basic research and ad-hoc administrative tasks to support team activities and efficiency.
* Supporting continuous process improvement

**About you**

* Currently studying a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Business Administration, Economics, Law, Marketing or similar
* Proficient written and verbal communication skills in English
* Well organised, detail-oriented and comfortable managing deadlines in a dynamic environment
* Are a proficient user of MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
* You are available to work approximately 10-15 hours per week on average

**What we can offer you**

* Commitment to your development
* Leaders guided by our Leadership Principles
* A culture that welcomes you as the unique person you are
* Inspiration from colleagues, clients, and projects
* A foundation-owned company with long-term thinking and a strong commitment to sustainability and integrity
* A supportive culture that invests in your professional development and encourages curiosity

**Ready to join us?**
Please submit your application and CV and supporting documents online. We invite diversity in all its forms and encourage applicants from all groups to apply.

Deadline: 15/12/2026 (Please note that we may close for applications early if we receive a large number of applications, so we encourage you to apply at your earliest convenience.)

**Work at the heart of sustainable change with Ramboll**
Ramboll is a global architecture, engineering, and consultancy company. As a foundation-owned people company, founded in Denmark, we believe that the purpose of sustainable change is to create a thriving world for both nature and people. So, that’s where we start – and how we work. Our history is rooted in a clear vision of how a responsible company should act and being open and curious is a cornerstone of our culture. Ramboll employs more than 18,000 people globally across 35 countries. Ramboll experts deliver innovative solutions across Buildings, Transport, Water, Environment & Health, Energy, Management Consulting, and Architecture & Landscape. Combining local experience with global knowledge, we help shape the societies of tomorrow.

**Equality, Diversity, and Inclusion**
Equality, diversity, and inclusion are at the heart of what we do. At Ramboll, we believe that diversity is a strength and that different experiences and perspectives are essential to creating truly sustainable societies. We are committed to providing an inclusive and supportive work environment where everyone is able to flourish and reach their potential. We also know how important it is to achieve the right balance of where, when, and how much you work. At Ramboll, we offer flexibility as part of our positive and inclusive approach to work. We invite applications from candidates of all backgrounds and characteristics. Please let us know if there are any changes we could make to the application process to make it more comfortable for you. You can contact us at job.advert.accessibility@ramboll.com with such requests.

# Studentermedhjælper til PKA’s investeringsafdeling

Virksomhed:
PKA

Lokation:
Hellerup

*Vil du kickstarte din karriere indenfor investeringer? Og få masser af praktisk erfaring med investeringer, analyser og spændende projekter? Så er du måske vores nye studentermedhjælper.*

Som studentermedhjælper i investeringsafdelingen får du ansvar fra første dag. Du får berøringsflader med flere områder indenfor investeringer fx aktie-, derivat-, hedge fund- og kreditinvesteringer, og du kan afprøve teorier fra dine studier i praksis. Du kommer til at arbejde selvstændigt og i tæt samarbejde med specialisterne i teamet, hvor du får stor indflydelse på, hvordan både drifts- og ad hoc-opgaver løses.

## Byg praktiske erfaringer på teori

Du bliver en del af et dynamisk arbejdsmiljø med gensidig respekt, en uformel omgangstone og en høj grad af eksekveringskraft. Dine opgaver vil for eksempel være:

* opfølgning på nuværende investeringer i samarbejde med porteføljemanagerne på både børsnoterede aktier, kreditobligationer, hedge fonde og derivater
* at udarbejde analyser og materiale til investeringskomiteen
* at vedligeholde forskellige investeringsanalyser
* diverse ad hoc-opgaver, hvor dine IT-kompetencer vil komme i spil

## Interesse for investeringer og nysgerrig af natur

Vi forestiller os, at du er studerende på en videregående uddannelse med fokus på økonomi, finansiering og/eller matematik, og at du har omkring et år tilbage af din bacheloruddannelse. Du har en naturlig interesse for investeringer og en stor lyst til at lære nyt.

Du har indgående kendskab til PowerPoint og Excel samt et kendskab til eller interessere i at lære Python, VBA, R, SQL, Power BI eller lignende.

Når vi møder dig, oplever vi dit gode humør og din positive indstilling. Du kan lide både at indgå i projekter med andre kolleger men også at løfte opgaver alene. Du har en nysgerrig, kvantitativ og analytisk tilgang og trives med forskellige arbejdsopgaver i din hverdag.

I rollen som studentermedhjælper bliver du en del af Investeringsafdelingen, hvor vi er 28 medarbejdere. Arbejdstiden er ca. 20 timer om ugen, og vi er fleksible med, hvordan du tilrettelægger din arbejdstid.

## Send din ansøgning – vi glæder os til at høre fra dig

Vi holder løbende samtaler, så tøv ikke med at sende din ansøgning inkl. CV og karakterudskrift. Du kan kontakte Chief Portefølje Manager, Flemming Cold på 21 44 68 86 eller flc@pka.dk, hvis du har spørgsmål.

jobs.description_md:
Vi søger studerende med stærke undervisnings- og formidlingskompetencer. Du bliver en del af vores hold af studenterundervisere i Politimuseets skoletjeneste.

Din primære opgave bliver at undervise børn og unge i kulturhistoriske temaer og dilemmaer, der knytter sig til politiet, dets historie og rolle i samfundet. Dertil varetagelse af kustodefunktionen på museet.

This role will serve as the right hand of the IT/Digital Cluster Lead making sure that the Project Managers and Agile Coaches have what they need to lead initiatives on behalf of our stakeholders.

We expect you to work 20 hours per week, preferably spread across two or three full days in the office.

Your primary focus will be on business operations, departmental coordination and information management, helping ensure that our processes, information and activities are well organised and up to date.

jobs.description_md:

You will join a small internal AI Team working across AI engineering, platform engineering, development and adoption. You will get real assignments with support from experienced colleagues and exposure to both the technical and practical questions involved in bringing AI into a global business.
